composition_note: Archetypes can be combined; they do not enumerate every vendor/deployment combination.

patterns.title: Centralized on-premises SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: A controlled enterprise estate with local processing and platform ownership.
patterns.topology: Site collectors feed a local bus and evidence platform; the response gateway reaches registered resources.
patterns.tradeoff: Local control brings platform, storage, skills, update and recovery obligations.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Enterprise sources] --> C[Collectors] --> Q[Local durable bus]
 Q --> D[Search and evidence tiers] --> A[Analyst cases]
 A --> G[Independent action gateway] --> T[Registered targets]
 D --> B[Independent backup]

constraints.decision: Separate management, workload and evidence trust zones.
constraints.failure_mode: A platform compromise reaches targets and erases evidence.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Boundary review and denied management-to-target paths.

constraints.decision: Identify shared power, storage, time, identity and license failures.
constraints.failure_mode: Redundant nodes share an indispensable dependency.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Dependency failure exercise and independent recovery options.

constraints.decision: Size local buffers and restoration for a stated outage.
constraints.failure_mode: Local placement is assumed resilient without tested restoration.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Measured backlog/restore trials and declared assumptions.

constraints.decision: Control privileged support and update import paths.
constraints.failure_mode: Support or media bypasses intended local authority.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Support records and failed package-admission cases.

patterns.title: Cloud-native SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Cloud-heavy services using managed event collection, storage and analytics.
patterns.topology: Regional subscriptions feed managed queues/data tiers; query and response identities remain separate.
patterns.tradeoff: Managed operations add region, API, identity, billing and supplier dependencies.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Cloud and SaaS sources] --> C[Scoped subscriptions]
 C --> Q[Regional ingest] --> D[Regional evidence]
 D --> A[Detection and cases] --> G[Scoped response] --> T[Approved resources]
 I[Identity and provider dependencies] -.-> Q
 I -.-> G

constraints.decision: Verify log enablement, delivery paths and provider API limits.
constraints.failure_mode: A cloud account exists while required logs are absent.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Permission checks and throttling/delivery-failure cases.

constraints.decision: Define storage, query, support and recovery placement independently.
constraints.failure_mode: A regional bucket masks foreign processing or administration.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Declared versus observed placement and supplier review.

constraints.decision: Include billing, licensing and account suspension in continuity.
constraints.failure_mode: Budget or account state stops collection or investigation.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Operating dependency review and degraded-mode decisions.

constraints.decision: Separate evidence access from cloud containment permissions.
constraints.failure_mode: Query access grants broad resource mutation.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Least-authority grants and foreign-resource denials.

patterns.title: Hybrid and multi-cloud SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Services spanning on-premises, several clouds and SaaS.
patterns.topology: Collectors join a governed fabric; shared cases retain original identity and provenance.
patterns.tradeoff: Coordination simplifies while identity, egress, queries and time semantics remain heterogeneous.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 O[On-prem collector] --> Q[Governed fabric]
 C1[Cloud A collector] --> Q
 C2[Cloud B collector] --> Q
 Q --> D[Authorized query and evidence] --> A[Cases]
 A --> G[Per-domain action policy]
 G --> T1[On-prem targets]
 G --> T2[Cloud A targets]
 G --> T3[Cloud B targets]

constraints.decision: Preserve provider/tenant-qualified identity through joins.
constraints.failure_mode: Equivalent names merge unrelated principals.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Cross-provider collision and scope cases.

constraints.decision: Decide where raw data remains and what crosses domains.
constraints.failure_mode: Centralization creates undocumented export.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Approved flow register and disclosure controls.

constraints.decision: Test normalization and queries per provider/backend.
constraints.failure_mode: One dashboard hides divergent meanings and missing data.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Backend-specific detection observations.

constraints.decision: Maintain separate action grants and failure modes per domain.
constraints.failure_mode: Central services inherit every administrator role.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Domain-specific allowed/denied and outage cases.

patterns.title: Security data lakehouse
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: High-volume retention with multiple analytics consumers.
patterns.topology: Raw/normalized tiers serve governed query engines, detections and cases independently of action authority.
patterns.tradeoff: Flexible analytics adds catalog, authorization, cost and lifecycle complexity.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Sources] --> N[Normalize with lineage] --> R[Raw and normalized tiers]
 R --> C[Governed catalog and queries]
 C --> D[Detection consumers]
 C --> A[Investigation consumers]
 D --> K[Cases] --> G[Independent response policy]

constraints.decision: Enforce authorization below each query/export engine.
constraints.failure_mode: Consumers bypass SIEM-level filters.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Direct storage/query/export denial cases.

constraints.decision: Handle late events, reprocessing and tier-specific lifecycle.
constraints.failure_mode: Late evidence is missed or deleted prematurely.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Backfill/reprocess/retention cases with lineage.

constraints.decision: Model duplicate tiers, indexes and query concurrency.
constraints.failure_mode: Cheap storage is presented as cheap complete analytics.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Unit assumptions and representative query measurements.

constraints.decision: Preserve data and interpretation metadata for exit.
constraints.failure_mode: Export loses schema, provenance or time meaning.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Alternative-engine import and paired detection cases.

patterns.title: Composable SOC platform
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Teams owning modular collectors, queues, analytics, case and response components.
patterns.topology: Components exchange versioned data, identity and authority contracts.
patterns.tradeoff: Flexibility requires integration, patch, support and recovery ownership.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 C[Collectors] --> Q[Event bus] --> D[Evidence platform]
 D --> E[Detection engine] --> K[Case platform]
 K --> G[Response gateway] --> T[Registered tools]
 V[Versioned contracts] -.-> Q
 V -.-> K
 V -.-> G

constraints.decision: Own every component and interface lifecycle.
constraints.failure_mode: Modularity is assumed to be operationally free.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Ownership register and patch/recovery plan.

constraints.decision: Validate identity, schema, retries and time semantics at interfaces.
constraints.failure_mode: Successful transport is mistaken for interoperability.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Contract and negative cases per component pair.

constraints.decision: Control plugin admission and privileged automation.
constraints.failure_mode: Convenient integrations gain unreviewed execution rights.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Admission and permission-change review.

constraints.decision: Observe end-to-end behavior and failure propagation.
constraints.failure_mode: Healthy individual tools leave a broken workflow.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Source-to-case/action and induced interface failures.

patterns.title: XDR-led SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: An estate relying heavily on provider-native endpoint, identity or network analytics.
patterns.topology: XDR evidence joins non-native sources and an enterprise case/decision layer.
patterns.tradeoff: Quick integration can coexist with proprietary logic and raw-evidence limits.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 E[Provider-native sources] --> X[XDR platform]
 N[Non-native sources] --> Q[Additional event path]
 X --> K[Enterprise cases]
 Q --> K
 K --> G[Independent policy] --> T[Targets]

constraints.decision: Identify required sources beyond native sensors.
constraints.failure_mode: Provider coverage is presented as whole-enterprise coverage.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Non-native source inventory and missing-source cases.

constraints.decision: Separate documented analytics from tested outcomes.
constraints.failure_mode: Technique lists are treated as demonstrated protection.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Positive/benign/missed cases and opaque internals.

constraints.decision: Keep export and alternative investigation usable.
constraints.failure_mode: Supplier failure makes original evidence unavailable.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Raw/case export and alternative-query exercise.

constraints.decision: Retain enterprise approval for consequential response.
constraints.failure_mode: Provider recommendations authorize business disruption.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Exact resource approvals and denied unapproved containment.

patterns.title: MDR and shared-responsibility SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Outsourced monitoring with retained enterprise risk and action ownership.
patterns.topology: Provider cases reach enterprise decision owners; selected evidence remains independently retained.
patterns.tradeoff: Coverage and skills add access, contract, handover and supplier concentration obligations.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Approved sources] --> M[MDR service]
 M --> K[Shared cases] --> O[Enterprise owner]
 O --> G[Scoped response] --> T[Enterprise targets]
 S --> E[Retained enterprise evidence]

constraints.decision: Agree coverage, response rights, escalation and retained duties.
constraints.failure_mode: An MDR contract implies a complete enterprise mandate.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: RACI, commitments and joint handover exercise.

constraints.decision: Limit supplier permissions by resource, tenant and purpose.
constraints.failure_mode: Convenience grants unrestricted administration.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Access review and foreign-resource denials.

constraints.decision: Maintain evidence, continuity and exit rights.
constraints.failure_mode: Supplier failure removes monitoring and investigation.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Retained data and alternate-operating procedure.

constraints.decision: Validate joint command and notification responsibility.
constraints.failure_mode: Supplier and enterprise act inconsistently or leave obligations unowned.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Joint exercise with responsible legal/service owners.

patterns.title: MSSP multi-tenant SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: A provider serving separately authorized customers.
patterns.topology: Tenant-qualified ingest, storage, cases, quotas and grants share selected infrastructure.
patterns.tradeoff: Shared efficiency increases isolation, admin and noisy-neighbor risks.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 A[Tenant A sources] --> IA[Tenant A ingest]
 B[Tenant B sources] --> IB[Tenant B ingest]
 IA --> DA[Tenant A evidence and cases] --> GA[Tenant A grants]
 IB --> DB[Tenant B evidence and cases] --> GB[Tenant B grants]
 P[Shared platform administration] -.-> DA
 P -.-> DB

constraints.decision: Enforce tenant isolation below consoles, caches, queues and stores.
constraints.failure_mode: UI labels are the only separation.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Cross-tenant read/write/cache/export denials.

constraints.decision: Separate customer keys, grants and approval owners.
constraints.failure_mode: Shared approval acts across unrelated customers.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Key/grant custody and mismatched-tenant denial.

constraints.decision: Protect per-tenant capacity and expose visibility loss.
constraints.failure_mode: One tenant exhausts shared capacity or hides dropped evidence.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Burst/isolation tests and tenant loss accounting.

constraints.decision: Authorize analyst assignment and supplier support per customer.
constraints.failure_mode: Global staffing automatically inherits all tenant rights.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Assignment, expiry and controlled case-sharing checks.

patterns.title: Federated national and regional SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Accountable agencies/regions retaining local data and decisions.
patterns.topology: Regional SOCs retain evidence and actions; central coordination receives approved freshness-aware summaries.
patterns.tradeoff: Distributed authority makes common policy, stale evidence and joint command explicit concerns.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S1[Regional sources] --> R1[Regional SOC and authority]
 S2[Other sources] --> R2[Other regional SOC]
 R1 --> E1[Approved export]
 R2 --> E2[Approved export]
 E1 --> C[Central coordination and freshness]
 E2 --> C
 C --> P[Reviewed packages] --> A[Local admission owners]

constraints.decision: Separate central coordination from local authority and custody.
constraints.failure_mode: Central systems assume unrestricted access or command.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Federation authority matrix and denied central actions.

constraints.decision: Carry freshness, uncertainty and disclosure constraints in export.
constraints.failure_mode: Silent sites are reported as currently protected.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Aged/missing reports and prohibited disclosure cases.

constraints.decision: Admit shared content locally with target/version checks.
constraints.failure_mode: A compromised coordinator pushes stale or executable authority.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Wrong-target/signer and replay/rollback admission cases.

constraints.decision: Exercise multi-owner command under connectivity loss.
constraints.failure_mode: Ambiguity prevents accountable local response.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Regional/central exercise and independent local decisions.

patterns.title: Sovereign connected SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Explicit jurisdiction, operator, key and supplier boundaries with connectivity.
patterns.topology: Approved local processing and keys use governed external feeds, support and exports.
patterns.tradeoff: Connectivity must not obscure external authority and disclosure obligations.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Scoped sources] --> L[Approved local processing]
 K[Independent key custody] -.-> L
 L --> A[Local cases and owners] --> G[Local response]
 L --> E[Approved export]
 U[Approved ingress] --> V[Local verification] --> L

constraints.decision: Define data, administrator, key, support, supplier and recovery authority separately.
constraints.failure_mode: Location is reported as proven sovereignty.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Declaration/observation/contract boundary register.

constraints.decision: Constrain feeds, support and exits by purpose and recipient.
constraints.failure_mode: Support or analytics creates uncontrolled disclosure.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Permitted/denied transfer and support cases.

constraints.decision: Restore within the required authority and placement scope.
constraints.failure_mode: Recovery relies on unapproved foreign operators or copies.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Scoped restore and independently reviewed placement.

constraints.decision: Separate connectivity from sovereignty assurance.
constraints.failure_mode: Disconnection is assumed to establish sovereignty.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Independent connectivity and authority acceptance records.

patterns.title: Strictly disconnected SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Local monitoring and response requiring no routine external connectivity.
patterns.topology: Local collection, identity, time, keys, analytics and response operate within the site; approved media/transfer procedures admit updates or export evidence.
patterns.tradeoff: Local autonomy brings local lifecycle, intelligence age, admission, staffing and recovery burdens.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Local sources] --> C[Local collectors] --> D[Local evidence and detections]
 I[Local identity and time] -.-> D
 D --> A[Local cases and owners] --> G[Local response]
 U[Approved offline packages] --> V[Quarantine and local admission] --> D
 A --> E[Approved offline evidence export]

constraints.decision: Remove or provide local alternatives for critical external runtime dependencies.
constraints.failure_mode: Cloud identity, DNS, time, licensing or certificate checks stop local operations.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Disconnected dependency inventory and measured unavailable-service cases.

constraints.decision: Verify physical transfer, content integrity and approval as separate controls.
constraints.failure_mode: A signed package is assumed safe or an air-gap diagram is assumed enforced.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Media custody, artifact/target checks and independently reviewed transfer enforcement.

constraints.decision: Operate local freshness, revocation and emergency authority deliberately.
constraints.failure_mode: Stale grants or intelligence create unbounded local permissions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Age/expiry/revocation exercises and retained decision owners.

constraints.decision: Maintain local restoration and tested clean recovery.
constraints.failure_mode: Evidence and keys require unreachable central services.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Clean-target restore with measured loss and remaining dependencies.

patterns.title: Intermittent edge and remote-site SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Remote sites that temporarily lose central connectivity.
patterns.topology: Local queues and permitted analysis/response remain available; resynchronization exports bounded data with freshness and deduplication.
patterns.tradeoff: Continuity depends on outage assumptions, local authority and safe reconciliation.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Remote sources] --> B[Local durable buffer] --> L[Local permitted analysis]
 L --> O[Local decision owner] --> G[Local scoped response]
 B --> X[Controlled reconnect and deduplication] --> C[Central SOC]
 C --> R[Reviewed updates] --> A[Local admission]

constraints.decision: Size durable buffers against explicit outage and burst assumptions.
constraints.failure_mode: Unmodeled outages cause silent loss or unsafe full-disk behavior.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Restart/full-buffer trials and overflow/loss policy.

constraints.decision: Bound local actions independently of central availability.
constraints.failure_mode: Lost connectivity grants unrestricted emergency response.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Local grant/expiry and denied escalation cases.

constraints.decision: Report delayed, missing or unverified site evidence centrally.
constraints.failure_mode: Last received telemetry is displayed as current.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Report-aging cases and clear visibility status.

constraints.decision: Reconcile duplicate events, cases, updates and action receipts on reconnect.
constraints.failure_mode: Repeated data or stale approvals duplicate actions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Resynchronization and authority-state replay tests.

patterns.title: OT and industrial SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Industrial operations with process safety, legacy equipment and strict change windows.
patterns.topology: Approved passive sensors feed an OT evidence zone; process owners govern maintenance and containment decisions.
patterns.tradeoff: Better visibility must respect safety, availability, protocol limits and engineering authority.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 P[Industrial processes] --> S[Approved passive sensors] --> Z[OT evidence zone]
 Z --> A[OT analyst cases] --> O[Process and safety owners]
 O --> M[Approved maintenance boundary]
 I[IT evidence] --> E[Controlled IT and OT correlation] --> A

constraints.decision: Approve passive/active collection and testing with process owners.
constraints.failure_mode: Security scans or sensor changes disrupt operations.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Safety review, approved method and bounded operating window.

constraints.decision: Separate OT and IT control/identity domains and permitted correlation.
constraints.failure_mode: IT compromise gains engineering command authority.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Zone/action matrix and denied cross-domain commands.

constraints.decision: Keep containment under engineering/safety authority.
constraints.failure_mode: Automatic isolation harms physical processes.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Consequential-action approval and safe alternate-response exercise.

constraints.decision: Plan local maintenance, updates and recovery for legacy dependencies.
constraints.failure_mode: Unsupported or externally dependent tooling breaks remote-site operation.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Lifecycle dependency and locally recoverable operating plan.

patterns.title: AI-assisted human-led SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Teams using AI for evidence summaries, query assistance and investigation support.
patterns.topology: Authorized context reaches a bounded assistant; analysts accept conclusions and independently authorized tools execute permitted actions.
patterns.tradeoff: Assistance adds instruction, retrieval, provider, model-update and confidence risks.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 E[Untrusted evidence] --> R[Permission-filtered retrieval] --> A[Bounded assistant]
 A --> P[Evidence-linked proposal] --> H[Analyst decision]
 H --> G[Independent action policy] --> T[Registered tools]
 C[Trusted subject and grants] -.-> R
 C -.-> G

constraints.decision: Authorize retrieval before data enters model context.
constraints.failure_mode: An unauthorized document is exposed before redaction.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Mixed-tenant/field retrieval and legitimate-context controls.

constraints.decision: Keep evidence text and model output outside the authority path.
constraints.failure_mode: Prompt injection or fabricated approval grants a tool action.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Instruction/approval-forgery cases and independent tool decisions.

constraints.decision: Review provider data, placement, retention and fallback.
constraints.failure_mode: A helpful summary sends confidential evidence to an unapproved service.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Allowed/denied provider routes and unavailable-model behavior.

constraints.decision: Evaluate outputs and admit changes with known limits.
constraints.failure_mode: An impressive demo becomes an assurance claim about real-model quality.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Task-specific factuality/usefulness tests, uncertainty and versioned re-evaluation.

patterns.title: Bounded closed-loop automation
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Low-impact or tightly governed repeatable actions with measurable permitted outcomes.
patterns.topology: Eligible events propose actions; independent policy applies scope, budget, approval and idempotency before dispatch and verification.
patterns.tradeoff: Speed increases the cost of policy mistakes, stale inputs, duplicated execution and partial failures.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 D[Eligible detection] --> P[Action proposal] --> G[Policy and approval gateway]
 G --> Q[Bounded idempotent dispatch] --> T[Registered target]
 T --> V[Independent outcome observation] --> K[Case record]
 S[Independent stop and budget control] -.-> G

constraints.decision: Limit eligible actions, resources, rate and blast radius.
constraints.failure_mode: One noisy or compromised detection disrupts an entire estate.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Wrong-resource and over-budget negative cases.

constraints.decision: Require exact approvals and fresh independent context for high-impact actions.
constraints.failure_mode: Automation bypasses business authority.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Expired/mismatched/replayed approval cases.

constraints.decision: Observe real target state and retain partial or failed outcomes.
constraints.failure_mode: Success messages are treated as verified containment.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Independent state check and interrupted/partial-effect evidence.

constraints.decision: Test retry, stop and compensation with explicit irreversibility.
constraints.failure_mode: Rollback promises exceed what an action can reverse.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Duplicate/interrupted action trials and owned residual decisions.

patterns.title: Follow-the-sun global SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Distributed analyst teams sharing approved workload across time zones.
patterns.topology: Region/tenant-scoped queues and evidence support a documented handover with authority expiry and accepted ownership.
patterns.tradeoff: Coverage depends on lawful access, staffing, fatigue, context continuity and actual acknowledgement.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 R1[Region A sources] --> Q[Region and tenant scoped queues]
 R2[Region B sources] --> Q
 Q --> A[Shift A analysts] --> H[Accepted evidence and authority handover]
 H --> B[Shift B analysts]
 B --> G[Region-specific action grants]

constraints.decision: Authorize staffing assignments and data access per region and customer.
constraints.failure_mode: Global coverage becomes unrestricted cross-border evidence access.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Assignment/access review and denied foreign-scope cases.

constraints.decision: Transfer ownership, evidence status and pending approvals explicitly.
constraints.failure_mode: A case is sent but not accepted by the next shift.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Acknowledged handover with unresolved decisions and timers.

constraints.decision: Model workload, leave, specialist availability and surge capacity.
constraints.failure_mode: Nominal time-zone coverage is treated as adequate incident capacity.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Rota and workload model followed by observed shift performance.

constraints.decision: Expire grants and reconcile concurrent shift actions.
constraints.failure_mode: Old and new shifts both act using stale approval.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Expiry, duplicate-action and ownership-switch cases.

patterns.title: Regulated and high-assurance SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Services requiring strong traceability, constrained privileges and independently reviewable evidence.
patterns.topology: Separated collection, analysis, evidence custody, key ownership and action approval support a scoped assurance process.
patterns.tradeoff: Higher assurance increases evidence, operational separation and change-management effort.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Scoped regulated sources] --> I[Controlled ingest] --> D[Protected evidence]
 D --> A[Authorized investigation] --> P[Independent approval]
 P --> G[Scoped action gateway]
 K[Separate key custodian] -.-> D
 R[Independent reviewer] -.-> D

constraints.decision: Establish applicable entity/sector/jurisdiction obligations before mapping.
constraints.failure_mode: A generic standards crosswalk is called certified compliance.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Owner-reviewed applicability and source/version record.

constraints.decision: Separate evidence custody, key ownership, approval and routine operations.
constraints.failure_mode: One administrator can act and erase accountability.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Duty separation and privileged-operation observations.

constraints.decision: Document custody, uncertainty and completeness limitations.
constraints.failure_mode: Hashes are claimed to prove trustworthy time or complete evidence.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Tamper/gap/time tests and independent anchoring gaps.

constraints.decision: Admit changes and exceptions through owned evidence gates.
constraints.failure_mode: Urgency creates indefinite unreviewed bypasses.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Change/exception expiry and reviewer acceptance.

patterns.title: Multi-region recovery SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Services needing defined continuity across permitted regional failure domains.
patterns.topology: Regional collection/data/case services replicate within approved boundaries; response authority and failback ownership are separately controlled.
patterns.tradeoff: Availability can conflict with placement, authority, replication cost and consistent action state.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Sources] --> A[Region A ingest and evidence]
 S --> B[Region B permitted ingest]
 A --> R[Approved replication and backup]
 R --> B
 A --> C[Case authority]
 B --> F[Controlled failover owner]
 C --> G[Action-state and approval reconciliation]
 F --> G

constraints.decision: Choose regions, dependencies and quorum within allowed boundaries.
constraints.failure_mode: Redundancy violates placement or still shares one critical dependency.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Failure-domain and authority/placement review.

constraints.decision: Define partition behavior and freshness-sensitive response.
constraints.failure_mode: A region acts on stale context or creates split-brain decisions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Partition exercise and explicit degraded action modes.

constraints.decision: Restore evidence and authorization/action state together.
constraints.failure_mode: Recovered approvals permit stale or repeated actions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: RPO/RTO measurement and replay-state restoration cases.

constraints.decision: Verify failback, duplicate handling and owned reconciliation.
constraints.failure_mode: Returning regions overwrite cases or repeat containment.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Failure/failback exercise with observed records and residual gaps.

patterns.title: Serverless and elastic SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: Bursty workloads where managed event, query and workflow services are suitable.
patterns.topology: Event triggers route to durable evidence and bounded analytics/workflows; independent authority checks precede response.
patterns.tradeoff: Elasticity remains constrained by quotas, cold starts, API rates, state and cost.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Events] --> Q[Durable event queue] --> F[Bounded functions]
 F --> D[Evidence and query services]
 F --> K[Cases and workflows]
 K --> G[Independent response policy] --> T[Registered targets]
 B[Quota and cost controls] -.-> F

constraints.decision: Model throttling, cold start, concurrency and finite retries.
constraints.failure_mode: Elastic services are assumed to have unlimited timely capacity.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Burst/throttle/retry measurements and backlog ownership.

constraints.decision: Use durable checkpoints and idempotency for repeated events.
constraints.failure_mode: Short-lived workers duplicate cases or actions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Worker interruption/replay and partial-effect cases.

constraints.decision: Scope function identities and protect configuration admission.
constraints.failure_mode: An event function acquires broad query and response privileges.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Per-function grants and untrusted-change cases.

constraints.decision: Bound query, execution, egress and model spend.
constraints.failure_mode: A hostile source creates a financially unbounded workflow.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Cost/rate budgets and overload/degraded behavior.

patterns.title: Small-team and resource-constrained SOC
patterns.stage: reference architecture; not a tested deployment
patterns.fit: An organization prioritizing essential visibility and accountable response within explicit staffing limits.
patterns.topology: A small governed source set feeds managed/composable analysis, a case queue and retained decision owners with clearly defined coverage.
patterns.tradeoff: Focus and outsourcing can help but do not create unstaffed coverage or universal detection.
patterns.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 S[Prioritized critical sources] --> D[Selected analysis service]
 D --> K[Owned review queue] --> O[Named response owner]
 O --> G[Limited approved actions]
 M[Optional scoped MDR support] --> K

constraints.decision: Prioritize critical sources and disclose excluded visibility.
constraints.failure_mode: A compact toolset is marketed as complete enterprise coverage.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Business-priority/source map with exclusions and gaps.

constraints.decision: State collection, staffed and on-call hours separately.
constraints.failure_mode: An unattended queue is represented as round-the-clock response.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Actual coverage and escalation exercise.

constraints.decision: Bound automation to accepted low-impact scopes and clear approvals.
constraints.failure_mode: Scarce staffing is compensated by unsafe broad automatic actions.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Allow/deny/budget and consequential-action approval cases.

constraints.decision: Fund lifecycle, recovery and specialist support as well as platform subscriptions.
constraints.failure_mode: Low license cost hides unsustainable operating requirements.
constraints.acceptance_evidence: Cost/workforce assumptions and retained supplier responsibilities.
